definitions.ccd: Sum of unique reachable-node counts, including the starting node exactly once.
definitions.changes: Post minus pre; propagation-cost changes are percentage points.
definitions.cross_group_edge_fraction: Direct edges with different endpoint groups / all direct edges.
definitions.cyclic_components: Strongly connected components of size > 1, or singleton nodes with explicit self-loops.
definitions.direct_counts: Distinct direct neighbors in the supplied graph; explicit self-loops, if present, count.
definitions.direct_edge_density: Non-self direct edges / [N * (N - 1)]; undefined for N = 1.
definitions.directed_modularity: Sum_g [L_g / m - K_out_g * K_in_g / m^2], resolution 1, on direct edges.
definitions.edge_direction: A -> B means A depends on B; edges are unweighted and deduplicated.
definitions.full_scope: Every node and edge in the supplied DOT graph, including isolated vendor nodes.
definitions.node_granularity: DOT module/program units, including main and isolated nodes.
definitions.partition: First directory beneath src; each root-level src file is its own group; vendors by library.
definitions.propagation_cost_percent: 100 * CCD / N^2; includes the visibility-matrix diagonal.
definitions.source_manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 records: relative_path + NUL + file_sha256 + newline.
definitions.src_scope: Induced subgraph of nodes mapped beneath src; remove vendor nodes before reachability.
definitions.transitive_counts: Unique nodes reachable by one or more edges, including direct neighbors but excluding self.
definitions.undefined_values: JSON null / empty CSV cells / 'undefined' in Markdown; modularity and cross-group fraction for m = 0.
